public_brief.objective: Keep the guest friendly and keep her at the table.
public_brief.tactic: Back down gracefully and turn the concession into an invitation to play.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer holds her gaze a moment too long, then lets his shoulders drop and spreads one pale hand toward the empty chair. The fresco-side player looks from him to her and says nothing.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: No, no, there is no need to trouble Harria with any of this, my lady. A guest of hers is a guest of mine, and this table has always been generous to its guests. Sit, warm yourself by the candles, and forget I ever mentioned the road. Shall I deal you in?
